title: StepWise
alt: StepWise inserting keys into an AVL tree, each step narrated with the pseudocode line highlighted
blurb: 100+ data structures and algorithms for university courses, one narrated step at a time. Step back, share as a link, embed in Canvas.

title: Digital Student Assistant
alt: Digital Student Assistant sign-in page: Bo explains, Kit asks you to explain
blurb: The AI teaching assistant my data structures students use now. It asks before it tells and won't hand over homework. Demo account: demo@hintwise.org.

title: Accessibility Lens
alt: Accessibility Lens scanning a page and replaying it as a screen reader, low-vision and color-blind visitor sees it
blurb: Paste your website's address and see what blind, low-vision, color-blind and keyboard-only visitors get, with a fix for each problem.

title: Code Viva
alt: Code Viva review tab with a flag queue of students who need a follow-up
blurb: Short written orals on each student's own code, so TA time goes to the few who need a conversation.

title: MyChessMaster
alt: MyChessMaster sample report: accuracy, critical moments and what to drill
blurb: For tournament players preparing for a specific opponent: where games went wrong, why, and drills from your own mistakes.

title: Chess TD
alt: Chess TD entering Swiss round results by keyboard, pairing the next round with an explanation of each pairing, and showing standings with tiebreaks
blurb: Run a chess tournament from your browser, even offline: Swiss and round-robin pairings by FIDE and US Chess rules, results by keyboard, standings with tiebreaks.

title: Bombe Bench
alt: Bombe Bench tracing an Enigma keypress, then breaking a message from a crib
blurb: An Enigma you can open up, and a working Turing-Welchman Bombe that breaks messages from a guessed word.

title: Cache Miss Theater
alt: Cache Miss Theater running row and column order loops through a cache
blurb: Watch a C loop's memory accesses run through a cache you configure, with every miss labelled.

title: Fork Count
alt: Fork Count listing every possible output of a fork/wait program
blurb: Every process and every possible output of a fork/wait/pipe program, and why the others are impossible.
